pages.title: Guild rules
pages.content:
A few short rules keep the hall a good place to hang out. Moderators apply them fairly and in the open; when a thread is moved, locked or removed, they say why.

  1. Be kind. Criticise plays, never people. No slurs, no harassment, no dogpiling.
  2. Tag spoilers. Story beats and leaks go behind a spoiler warning, never in a topic title.
  3. Right channel. Post where your topic belongs. Moderators may move threads that wander.
  4. No cheats, no trading. No cheat links, account sales or real-money trades.
  5. Keep it legal and safe. No personal information about other people, no pirated content.

What happens when a rule is broken

A first slip gets a friendly note. Repeated or serious breaks lose posting rights, temporarily or for good. If you think a moderator got it wrong, write to the team from the About page.

pages.title: About Guild Hall
pages.content:
Guild Hall started as a raid group chat and grew into a home for players of every game: competitive grinders, story fans and people who just want someone to play co-op with on a Sunday.

Who runs the hall

A small team of volunteer moderators, all of them active players. They keep the channels tidy, run the community nights and answer reports, usually within a few hours.

  • Juno Park, community lead
  • Nyx, raid leader and moderator

Get in touch

Questions, partnership ideas or something a moderator should see? Post in the Announcements channel or write to the team at team@example.com.

topics.author: nyx
topics.title: How to write a good LFG post
topics.content:
A good LFG post gets answers in hours, a vague one gets none. Put these in your title: [region] role, game mode, schedule.

In the post, say your rank or experience, your time zone and what kind of group you want (chill, tryhard, learning). Update the title with [FULL] when you are done.

replies.author: kaito
replies.content: Adding the schedule to the title made a huge difference for me.

replies.author: vela
replies.content: Please also say if you use voice chat. It saves everyone time.

topics.author: nyx
topics.title: Healer build for season 4: survive the burst phases
topics.content:
The new boss phases punish greedy healing. This build trades a little throughput for two defensive cooldowns and it has carried our heroic progress.

Core idea: pre-shield before the burst, save the big heal for the second wave, and never stand in the purple.

replies.content: Works well with a support that can cleanse, too.

replies.author: nyx
replies.content: Good point, I will add a section on pairing with supports.
